instruction: Refill the user's reusable water bottle and deliver it to them.
Prepare a cup of boiled water and deliver it to the user.
On a chilly winter morning, prepare the bathroom by pouring hot water from the kettle into a bowl placed on the bathroom counter, then bring a clean cup for rinsing.
Go to the kitchen, get the mug from bench, fill it at sink, and bring the filled mug to person in bathroom and hand it over.
Take a glass from the dining table, fill it with water at the kitchen sink, and hand the filled glass to person in empty_room.
Pick up the reusable water bottle from the dining_table, walk to sink in kitchen to fill it with water, then hand the filled water bottle to person at dining_table.
Go to kitchen, pick up the teapot from sink, fill it from the faucet, and hand the filled teapot to person in bedroom.
Fill the electric_kettle on sink with water, power it on to heat, pour the hot water into the mug on dining_table, then hand the mug to person in bathroom.
Move a decorative plant container from the entryway to the dining room counter, place a bowl and fork from the kitchen onto the dining table, and bring a box from the closet to the table for snacks.
Refill a reusable water bottle and deliver it to the resident.
Collect used plates and cups from the living room, bring toy items from the shelf to the bedroom, and close all opened cupboards in the kitchen.
Pick up the reusable water bottle from desk in the bedroom, take it to the sink at sink_cabinet in the laundryroom, fill it with water from the faucet, then return and place it back on desk.

Arrange the dining table with the statue, vase, cap, plate, and teapot from the dining room and kitchen, bring a candle from the laundry room to the dining table, light the candle, and place a bowl of fruit on the table.
Fetch the watering_can from the utility area, fill the watering_can at sink, and hand the filled watering_can to the person in utility_room.
Pick up the watering_can from bench, fill it at sink in the kitchen, then pour water into vase and vase in living_room.
Refill a drinking container with tap water and deliver it to the person in the corridor.
Could you make a coffee and bring it to my friend in the game room?
Could you make me a cup of hot water and bring it down here?
Fill the kettle with water from the sink and place it on the stove to heat.
Prepare a cup of hot water and bring it to the person.
Prepare a cup of hot water for the user.
Take the electric_kettle from the kitchen_cabinet to the kitchen_island, fill it with water at sink_cabinet, power it on to heat, then pour hot water into a mug on table.
Fill a watering can at the kitchen sink and use it to water the potted plant located on the vase in the playroom (vase in playroom).
Ensure the user's reusable water bottle is filled with water and ready for them to take to work.
Could you fill a cup with water and bring it to my room, please?
Go to the kitchen, fill the kettle with water from the faucet, and boil it to prepare tea.
Fill a plastic cup with water at sink in kitchen and bring it to the child in bedroom, handing it to her.
Fill the electric kettle at sink (kitchen) with water, power it on to boil, pour the boiled water into a cup on dining_table, and deliver the cup to person in bedroom.
Fetch a small snack and a drink for the child.
Bring your laptop and a notebook from your bedroom to the office for studying, grab a cup of hot tea from the kitchen, and also bring your watch from the office to keep track of your study breaks.
Retrieve the reading glasses from nightstand and the bonsai care book from desk, bring them to the bathroom, and hand them to the person there.

Reset the house: relocate a watch and spectacles from bedroom_1 to office_1, clear an old box and cushion from closet_1 to hallway_1, bring a glass and tea kettle to kitchen_1, put a soap dispenser in bathroom_1, and move a stuffed toy from bedroom_2 to closet_2.
Refill the student's reusable water bottle and place it in her bedroom so it's ready for her study session.
Retrieve the portable induction stove and hot pot saucepan from kitchen_cabinet, place them on kitchen_island, fill the saucepan with water, and power on the stove.
I need my hot water — please make me a cup and bring it here.
On a chilly morning, power on the electric kettle in the kitchen and prepare a cup for green tea before your video calls.
I'm cold and tired — can you make me a cup of tea and bring it out to the garage?
Go to the kitchen and fill the watering can with water from the sink, then water the plants in the living room.
Prepare bathing items and a change of clothes for the user so they can take a shower.
Collect your laptop from the bedroom, a lamp from the living room, a notebook (box) from the bedroom, and set up a remote work station on the table in the living room for afternoon work.
I'm filthy from work — can you run me a hot bath and bring my towel?
Go to the kitchen and pick up the vegetables and meat from the refrigerator and kitchen cabinet to prepare a hot pot.
Prepare for a family baking afternoon by collecting cups and plates from the office, bedroom, and dining booth, then arrange them on the kitchen table.
Go to the kitchen and pick up the seafood from the refrigerator to prepare a dish.
Go to bedroom, pick up a clean towel from bed, bring it to bathroom and place it on sink, then power on the air_purifier on sink.

Set up the living room for movie time by bringing snacks (a plate, a bottle, and a bowl) from the kitchen, extra cushions from bedroom_2, and a blanket from bedroom_1. Place a stuffed toy from bedroom_2 to comfort the younger child. Keep a clock on the tv stand to manage screen time, and set up a spray bottle for easy cleaning after snacks.

Collect scissors, tape, and colored pencils from the closet, office, and bedrooms. Set up all materials on the kitchen table for a family craft night, then power on the multiport hub in the living room so everyone can charge their devices during the activity. Afterwards, clean up by putting all used materials back in their original rooms.
Fill the kettle with water from the faucet and power it on to heat the water.
Go to the kitchen, take the electric_kettle from the sink area, fill and power it to heat water, then pour the hot water into the instant_noodle_cup on the dining_table and bring a spoon.
Could you clear my tea things from the dining table and put them away in the kitchen?
After cooking a Yunnan specialty on a rainy afternoon, put away all spice and herb items from the fridge and kitchen counter into the kitchen cabinet.
Fill the watering_can at sink and pour water into vase in bathroom to water the plant.

Gather all your toy construction sets and toy vehicles from the bedroom, family room, closet, and living room. Also, bring together some toy food, a tray, an extra plate, and a cup from the kitchen and entryway. Scatter the vehicles and construction sets in the hallway and entryway for your convoy, and set up a pretend picnic on the living room table with the toy food, plate, cup, and tray.
Go to the kitchen, fill and switch on the electric kettle, pour hot water into the ceramic mug on the kitchen island, and hand the mug to the person in the kitchen.
Go to the kitchen, pick up the blender from the kitchen cabinet, and gather fruits from the refrigerator to make a smoothie.
Take a book from the office for quiet time in the bedroom, bring a canister of cookies from the kitchen to the living room for snacks, and retrieve a watch from the closet to check the time.
Go to the kitchen and clean the coffee maker and the kitchen cabinets.
Go to the kitchen, use the coffee machine to brew a cup of coffee into a mug, and place the mug on the kitchen island.
Prepare and deliver a warm drink to a person in another room.
Could you make me a cup of tea and bring it to my home office, please?
Pick up the reusable_water_bottle from dining_table, take it to sink in kitchen, fill it with water, and hand it to person.
Before a family dinner, arrange plates, spoons, and a casserole on the dining table and check if there is a pitcher of water (jug) present.
Go to the kitchen and pick up seafood from the refrigerator to prepare a meal.
At dusk, bring a vase and freshen it by filling it with water from the kitchen faucet, then place it back on the bedroom stool.
Go to the kitchen, fill the coffee machine with water, load coffee grounds, brew a cup into the ceramic mug, and hand the mug to the person in the kitchen.
Before heading out for your morning walk, make sure your cellphone is charged and placed on your bedside chest of drawers.
The plants need a drink — can you fill the watering can and water my vegetable patch outside?
Before dinner, take the casserole from the dining room and reheat it in the kitchen oven. After heating, power off the oven and return the casserole to the dining room table.
After coming back from the local market, sort all hats and bags found in the closet, placing hats on the closet shelves and bags on the bench in the garage.
Organize and tidy up the closet in your bedroom before the summer rainy season arrives by adding a canister for small items and arranging your child's toy vehicles.

Return the kettle from the fridge in the kitchen to the correct cabinet, pick up any cups from the living room coffee table and place them in the dishwasher, and gather any books from the bedroom to the office shelf.
Prepare bathing supplies and warm water in the bathroom for a post-work shower.

Gather the laptop cover and mouse pad from the bedroom and office, respectively, and place them in the office desk drawer, move a multiport hub from the living room to the kitchen, and place a book on your bedroom nightstand.
Could you fill the watering can and water my herbs on the coffee table, please?
Prepare a hot morning beverage and deliver it to the resident's bedroom.

Arrange ambient lighting by switching on lamps in the bedroom and office, tidy up by moving scattered books from the dining room, office, and closet to the bedroom shelf, and bring a festive candle from the closet to the dining table.
Could you make some hot tea and bring a cup to the person at the dining table?
Fill the kettle with water from the faucet and then power it on to heat the water.
Set a candle holder and mooncakes on the dining room table, bring your favorite indie music album (CD) from the bedroom to the living room, and take a bottle of tea from the kitchen to enjoy.
Please wipe down the dining table and put the air freshener there.

Pick up the electric kettle and a mug from the dining table, fill the kettle at the kitchen sink, power it on to heat the water, pour hot water into the mug, and bring the mug to the person in bathroom.

Collect your laptop cover from the unknown room and your toy animal from the bedroom, then store them in the closet. Bring your favorite stuffed toy to the living room couch for movie time and leave a bowl in the kitchen for a late snack prep.
On a cold winter day, pour hot water into a thermos bottle and place it on the bedroom chest of drawers so I can have warm water during the night.
Before bedtime, bring a bath towel and soap dispenser to the bathroom from your closet and bedroom for your shower routine.
Prepare a quick cup of instant noodles.
Can you tidy up my desk and turn on the lamp for me?
Could you please make me a warm cup of boiled water and bring it here?
Turn on the floor lamp and arrange the coffee table for studying in the living room.

Place a flower vase from the entryway on the main dining table, move a candle from bedroom_1 to the dining room, bring a plate of fruits from the kitchen, and open the dining room window for fresh air.
Prepare a gourmet coffee and deliver it to the person in the bedroom.
Prepare a hot cup of coffee in the kitchen and deliver it to the bedroom nightstand.

Tidy up quickly: move any stray box from the living room to the closet, shift a backpack from the hallway to the bedroom, pick up a bottle from the bathroom and return it to the kitchen, then close the fridge after checking contents.
Refill a reusable water bottle and make it available in the kitchen.
Can you tidy up the coffee table and put the books back on the shelf?
